items.title: Expired contract rates invoiced for 18 months
items.description: A ground handling contract at DXB expired without renewal notice. The vendor continued invoicing at the old rates plus an unagreed 8% CPI increase. By the time finance flagged it, 18 months of disputed invoices had accumulated totaling $2.1M.
items.recommendation: Always verify contract end dates. Set alerts 90 days before expiry. Ensure auto-renewal clauses have caps and notice periods.

items.title: Missing wide-body differential cost $400K/year
items.description: A handling contract at SIN had a single flat rate for all aircraft types. When the airline introduced A380 service, the vendor charged the same rate as A320 handling. A competitor quote showed wide-body rates should be 60% higher.
items.recommendation: Always define separate rates for narrow-body (Code C), wide-body (Code E), and super-heavy (Code F) aircraft.

items.title: Uncapped CPI escalation doubled rates in 5 years
items.description: A cargo handling contract had CPI escalation with no cap. Over 5 years, cumulative CPI increases of 6-8% per year compounded to a 47% total increase.
items.recommendation: Always negotiate a CPI cap (typically 3-5% per annum). Specify the exact CPI index to use.

items.title: No cancellation terms caused $180K penalty dispute
items.description: When COVID-19 reduced flights, the airline cancelled services at multiple stations. Contracts without cancellation notice terms resulted in vendors claiming full-month charges for cancelled services.
items.recommendation: Every contract must have clear cancellation terms: notice period (30/60/90 days), partial cancellation rights, and force majeure clauses.

items.title: Volume tier threshold missed — overpaid $95K
items.description: A handling contract had volume tiers: 0-500 flights at $850/flight, 501-1000 at $780/flight, 1000+ at $720/flight. The airline operated 1,050 flights but the vendor invoiced all at the mid-tier rate.
items.recommendation: Track flight volumes against tier thresholds monthly. Set alerts when approaching tier breaks.
